title: Finite polynomial algebra action on successive coherent formal kernels
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Put $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and let $F$ be a coherent formal module for $J$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Write $K_0=F_1$ and $K_{n+1}=\ker(F_{n+2}\to F_{n+1})$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. Then there is $r\in\mathbf N$ such that the polynomial ring $P=A[T_1,\ldots,T_r]$, graded by total degree with homogeneous submodules $P_k$, acts on the pieces by $\mathcal O_X$-linear sheaf maps $\mu_{m,k}(b):K_m\to K_{m+k}$, additive in $b\in P_k$. They satisfy $\mu_{m+l,k}(b)\circ\mu_{m,l}(b\prime)=\mu_{m,k+l}(bb\prime)$ for $b\in P_k,b\prime\in P_l$, and constants $a\in A=P_0$ act on sections by $f^\sharp(a)$. For each point $x\in X$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ and finitely many sections $t_i\in K_0(U)$ such that, for every $m$, every open $V\subseteq U$, every $v\in K_m(V)$ and every $y\in V$, some open $y\in W\subseteq V$ has $v|_W$ in the $\mathcal O_X(W)$-span of $\mu_{0,m}(b)(t_i|_W)$ for $b\in P_m$. No properness, ample sheaf or cohomological assertion is assumed.

proof.text: Choose r and a Fin r-indexed generating family for I using Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing and Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family. This is the only use of Noetherianity of the coefficient ring.

Apply formalSystems_kernel_rees_finite to J=I O_X and F. Obtain its associated graded algebra G, its unit and representative multiplication identities, and the graded module M on the formal kernel pieces, locally generated by finitely many degree-zero sections.

Apply formalAssociatedGraded_polynomial_cover to the chosen generators and G. Obtain natural additive evaluation maps e on homogeneous polynomials, preserving multiplication and constants, and locally spanning finite families of coefficients in each algebra piece.

Construct gradedActHom from the bilinear action of e(k,U,b), checking naturality on opens. Compose with eqToHom for k+m=m+k to obtain mu(m,k,b). Extensionality and linearity prove additivity. Pointwise heterogeneous extensionality, the graded module associativity identity and the multiplicativity of e prove the composition identity. The constant formula for e, linearity of G.unit, bilinearity of the action and one_act prove the displayed scalar formula. All degree transports are proved by equality induction in private helpers.

Use the finite degree-zero generators of M. For v on V and y in V, their generating formula supplies W and coefficients a_i. Shrink W to Z using the polynomial cover simultaneously for the finite family a_i. Restrict the generating finite sum to Z by map_comp_apply, map_sum and M.naturality. For each summand, apply Submodule.span_induction to its restricted coefficient, using the linear map obtained by fixing the generator in M.act. Evaluation generators land in the required span by happ; zero, sum and scalar cases use submodule closure. Sum the resulting memberships. This is a complete Lean proof of the local-generation clause, with no new hole.

lean.statement: theorem formalKernel_polynomial_action {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (F : CoherentFormalModule X ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)) : ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A k → (formalKernelPiece F m ⟶ formalKernelPiece F (m + k)), (∀ (m k : ℕ) (b b' : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A k), mu m k (b + b') = mu m k b + mu m k b') ∧ (∀ (m k l : ℕ) (b : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A k) (b' : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A l), HEq (mu m l b' ≫ mu (m + l) k b) (mu m (k + l) ⟨b.val * b'.val, b.property.mul b'.property⟩)) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A) (U : X.Opens) (t : (formalKernelPiece F m).val.obj (op U)), HEq ((mu m 0 ⟨MvPolynomial.C a, MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (Fin r) a⟩).val.app (op U) t) ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a) • t)) ∧ (∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧ ∃ (s : ℕ) (t : Fin s → (formalKernelPiece F 0).val.obj (op U)), ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (v : (formalKernelPiece F m).val.obj (op V)) (y : X), y ∈ V → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧ (formalKernelPiece F m).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op v ∈ Submodule.span ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op W)) {z | ∃ (i : Fin s) (b : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A m), HEq z ((mu 0 m b).val.app (op W) ((formalKernelPiece F 0).val.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op (t i)))})
